evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the internal HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp to handle pipelined requests properly.
rationale: Fixes a regression from the libevent replacement where the HTTP server executed pipelined requests after a close response without returning responses, violating RFC 9112 §9.6. As noted in the description, 'clients expecting unserved requests to be unexecuted may retry them, leading to duplicate execution of RPCs with side effects', an issue also flagged by the red team.
